versions.olmo_content: Appendix C 'Introspection Across OLMo-3.1-32B's Training Pipeline': one paragraph stating per-stage TPR and FPR in prose (it opens by naming Figure 21); Figure 21 caption: rates aggregated across L in [25,32,38,45,51] with alpha in [1,2,4,8]; the figure is an image (olmo-staged-introspection.png, alt text 'Refer to caption') with no data table. Section 3.3 ('The Role of Post-Training') points to Appendix C and also says in text that base and SFT have high FPR, which reaches 0% only after DPO (no per-stage TPR numbers there). No per-(layer, alpha) breakdown; no n; no concept count.

Appendix C is 'Abliterated Model Details' (no OLMo). OLMo per-stage results are Figure 5 (Section 3.3) at L=25, alpha in {1,2,4,8}, over the original 50 Lindsey (2025) concepts, plus Appendix D.1 Figure 20 at L=19 and L=22. No numeric per-stage TPR/FPR in text. Table 3 is a LoRA fine-tuning study on the OLMo SFT checkpoint (L=25, alpha=4); its starred official-checkpoint rows read TPR-FPR SFT* -11.5 +/- 2.4, DPO* +9.8 +/- 0.5.
Same structure as v2 (Appendix C abliteration; OLMo in Figure 5 at L=25; D.1 at L=19/22); no numeric per-stage TPR/FPR in text.
